entry.name: route
entry.digest: Select outlet based on input matching
entry.description: Tries to match a message's first argument to the route object's own arguments. The rightmost outlet passes any message that matched no other choice, so you may gang route objects to get more choices

arguments.name: selectors
arguments.description: Arguments can be a mix of ints, floats, or symbols. The number of arguments determines the number of outlets, in addition to the rightmost outlet. Each argument assigns a name or a number to an outlet. If there is no argument, there is one other outlet, which is assigned the number.
